csv_project_name: CMAR For West Chatham Athletic Complex
csv_scope_of_work: The intent of these specifications is to solicit formal sealed proposals from firms qualified to provide Construction Management at Risk (CMR) Services for the (ESPLOST) RFP C27-01 for Construction Manager at Risk ( CMR ) Services for West Chatham Schools Project located at 820 Pine Barren Road, Pooler, GA 31322. This RFP is seeking Construction Management at Risk (CMR) proposals for the construction of a new high school, new K-8 school, and athletic complex. The successful contractor will enter into a contract directly with the school district and must assume all the responsibilities and duties of a direct contract The architect for the project is Hussey Gay Bell DeYoung International. Programming/Schematic Design is currently in progress.
